title: Siege
order_note: Sorted by recording id: C (cinematics), M (in-engine cutscenes), T (gameplay transmissions); unit barks follow their trigger group. Interleaving of C/M/T is not confirmed.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We need to buy Andorhal time until Uther returns with reinforcements. Let’s move.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Thank you, stranger. You’re from the capital, aren’t you? Is it true that Arthas set it aflame?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It is. Lord Uther ordered us to regroup in Andorhal. He’s gathering troops to break the siege.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: He may already be too late. The cult is preparing to launch a massive assault on the city.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: I had planned to muster troops for a preemptive strike, but first we need to establish a base.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We can help with that. If we keep the cult occupied, we can delay their attack until Uther arrives.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Very well. Ilastar Songbreeze, at your service.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Garek Bandarion, at yours. Let’s fight some cultists.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Lord Uther! Are these all of the reinforcements?

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I’m afraid so. With the Silver Hand disbanded, we paladins are spread thin across Lordaeron.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: No... that bell means that the cult has breached the gates!

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Then the real battle has begun.

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Lead your forces into the city while my paladins and I flank the cultists outside the walls.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Yes, sir! We won’t let Andorhal fall to the Scourge!

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: No! You will not deny me my reward!

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Within Stratholme, I will be granted power everlasting! When next we meet, you will all die!

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Andorhal is secure, though it will take time to rebuild it.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Stratholme was Rivendare’s seat of power. If that’s where the cult is gathering, he’ll be there too.

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I know he struck down your captain. But the Light calls us to protect those who yet live. Trust in its judgment, Lieutenant Bandarion.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I can't just sit behind these walls while Rivendare goes unpunished.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]I can't just sit behind these walls while Rivendare goes unpunished.[/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Nor can I. The Light calls for retribution as well, and we must deliver it to the cult.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Nor can I. The Light calls for retribution as well, and we must deliver it to the cult.[/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then that’s what we’ll do. We ride for Stratholme, before Lord Uther says otherwise.

lines.scene: User Base Start.User Base Start Fight Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: These wretched cultists will not win the day!

lines.scene: User Base Start.User Base Start Fight Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Theyre under attack! Forward!

lines.scene: User Base Start.User Base Start Paesant Rescue Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: We need to repair the Lumber Mill if this is to be a proper base.

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Start Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Off to a good start, but we'll need more resources to build an army.

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Start Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: There are other settlements nearby. We should reclaim them as well.

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Approach Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Here's one of the outlying settlements. Good people once called it home.

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Approach Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We'll need to bring in workers from our base to begin repairs.

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Blacksmith Retrieved Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: At least the cult didn't slaughter the horses.

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Blacksmith Retrieved Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Our knights will ride them into battle and avenge the fallen.

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Sanctuary Retrieved Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: This was a house of worship! Is nothing sacred to these heathens?!

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Sanctuary Retrieved Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Your fellow priests will smite them in return.

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Fair Retrieved Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: The family who lived here wanted a quiet life outside of the city.

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Fair Retrieved Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We'll make use of their provisions and bring their killers to justice.

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Gunshop Retrieved Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: I knew the owners of this gunshop. They took pride in their craft.

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Gunshop Retrieved Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Their wares will arm our riflemen and fill the cult with lead.

lines.scene: Optional Quest - Cleanse The Countryside.Optional Quest Cleanse Discover Event Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The cult's undead minions seem endless in number.

lines.scene: Optional Quest - Cleanse The Countryside.Optional Quest Cleanse Discover Event Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Their fetid ghouls will continue to swarm us unless we destroy their plague cauldrons.

lines.scene: Plague Cauldrons.Plague Cauldrons Countryiside Defeated Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: That should afford us a little more breathing room.

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: It seems we have unwelcome company. Exterminate them.

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: My master bids this city annihilated! I will see it done!

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Only a fool would dare to oppose the Cult of the Damned.

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Andorhal will burn like the rest of Lordaeron. You cannot stop us!

lines.scene: Ras Bossfight.Ras Bossfight Half Life Q
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Why struggle in futility? The Scourge reigns supreme.

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Stubborn imbeciles! I will return with even greater forces!

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: You will pay dearly for your insolence! This isn't over!

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: I've dealt with worse miscreants than you! Victory will be mine!

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: This is a mere distraction! More pressing matters await my attention!

lines.scene: Point of Interest.Point of Interest Enter Andorhal Start Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The forest is clear. Now to break the rest of the siege.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: If we retake the guard towers, we can drive this vile cultists out of Andorhal!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The militia is fighting in the streets! We'll join forces with them!

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: These people need our help!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Save everyone you can!

lines.scene: Optional Quest - Destroy The Plague Cauldrons.Optional Quest PCauldrons Discover Event Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: More plague cauldrons. We should destroy them before the city is overrun!

lines.scene: Optional Quest - Reinforcements.Optional Quest Reinforce Discover Event Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: If we clear a path for Uther's paladins, they can join us in the city streets.

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Enough of your meddling. I'll deal with you permanently!

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Yes my liege?

lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: I'm your shooter!

lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Aye sir!

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: For Lordaeron!

lines.speaker: Footman

lines.speaker: Priest
